message:
simd/internal/spec: clean up mathlib_test.go with better helpers

This introduces assertFn1 and assertFn2 to make the tests in
mathlib_test.go much less verbose and repetitive. It takes advantage
of the brand new support for untyped literals to provide extremely
low-noise test tables.
